note: Stanislaus NF campground on Hwy 108 (Sonora Pass road) opposite Dardanelle Resort, in mixed conifers beside the Middle Fork Stanislaus; two trails lead down to the river. Concessionaire-run. The nearest RV dump is near Pinecrest, and free RV water is at the old Brightman Flat fire station. --Claude
